fee_notes: Royalty is 5% of Gross Revenue; successor or multiple master franchise agreement holders may qualify for a lesser rate, including a 1% reduction if Single Entity Gross Revenue exceeds $16,292,359/year or Multiple Entity combined Gross Revenue exceeds $24,438,540/year. Business Development Fee (marketing analog) is currently 0.5% of Gross Revenue, adjustable up to 1.5%; Area Franchisors who began paying when the fee was implemented in 2025 pay a discounted rate of 0.3%, also adjustable up to 1.5%. Canadian Area Franchisors are not charged a Business Development Fee. Additional fees include: Transfer Fee $10,000 (waived for immediate family/controlling owner transfers); Renewal/Successor Term Fee $10,000; On-Boarding Fee $10,000 (non-refundable); Late Payment interest at prime rate or highest legal rate; Indemnity; Insurance estimated at ~2% or more of Gross Revenue if participating in group plan; Enforcement Costs and Audit Expense (audit cost payable if underpayment exceeds 10%).
raw_excerpt:
Royalty2: 5% of your Gross Revenue, but Area Franchisors entering successor or multiple master franchise agreements may be charged a lesser royalty fee rate. Due: 10th day of each month.
Business Development Fee4: Currently .5% of your Gross Revenue, although we can increase it occasionally, up to 1.5%. Due: 10th day of each month. Area Franchisors that began paying this fee when it was implemented in 2025 pay a discounted fee (.3%) as of the date of this Disclosure Document, which is also subject to adjustment by us up to 1.5%.
Late Payments: Prime rate of interest or highest applicable legal rate on all amounts not timely paid. On demand.
Transfer Fee: $10,000, unless transfer is to an immediate family member or the owner with a controlling interest. Upon or prior to certain transfers of the franchise.
Renewal (Successor Term) Fee: $10,000. 30 days before term of franchise expires.
On-Boarding Fee5: $10,000. Not less than 3 business days before you participate in a scheduled session.
Indemnity: You must indemnify, defend and hold Vanguard harmless from claims against Vanguard resulting from your acts or omissions or relating to your business as described in the Master Franchise Agreement. Upon demand.
Insurance: We estimate insurance costs will be approximately 2% or more of your Gross Revenue, if you participate in general liability, crime and umbrella liability insurance coverage plans we currently offer. When due to insurance carrier.
Enforcement Costs: Cost to collect payments from you or to enforce post termination/expiration/assignment terms of the Franchise Agreement. On demand.
Interest on Underpayments & Audit Expense: Prime rate of interest or highest applicable legal rate on underpaid amounts. Possible costs of audit. On demand.
